summary: Some signs of overfitting: read the findings.

findings.title: Generalisation gap
findings.explanation: The model scores about the same on rows it trained on as on the test, so it learned more than it memorised.

findings.title: Calib vs test
findings.explanation: Calib and test agree within their confidence intervals.

findings.title: Train/test overlap
findings.explanation: Some test inputs also appear, exactly or nearly, in the training rows.

examples.test: Asian Stocks Lower, Greenspan Awaited  SINGAPORE (Reuters) - Asian stocks edged lower on Wednesday  as profit taking set in after two days of gains and the dollar  firmed ahead of comments from Fed chief Alan Greenspan that are  expected to cement the case for further U.S. rate rises.

examples.test: In Haiti, Peacekeepers Take on Militants Using armored cars and earth movers, U.N. peacekeepers and Haitian police moved into an area early Sunday controlled by militants loyal to ousted President Jean-Bertrand Aristide, protecting workers removing burned out cars used as road blocks.

findings.title: Selection pressure
findings.explanation: 3 experiments were compared on calib; the winner leads by more than chance would give.

findings.title: Learning curve
findings.explanation: Dev levelled off before training ended, with no late drop.
